region.value: KSA — neutral Saudi register (Riyadh fitness + wellness, outdoor public spaces)

tone_register.value: calm-motivational — aspirational progress without aggression; Saudi in restraint, not in loudness

quality_tier.value: upper-universal — professional accessible, not exclusive; community over luxury

modesty_register.value: STRICT (Saudi default — no skin; full-length modest activewear only; no locker-room or bedroom settings; all scenes public gym floor or outdoor)

primary.value: Deep charcoal (~#1F2A2E) as the primary brand anchor; energising teal-green (~#1FAD6E) as the active accent; clean white (~#F8F8F8) as the breathing ground. The combination reads professional fitness without aggression.

background_tone.value: Clean white or light grey studio for product shots. Outdoor morning light (cool-to-warm) for activity shots. Public park green, gym rubber black, or corniche concrete are the legitimate environmental grounds. NEVER bedrooms, NEVER locker rooms.

color_field_palette.value: Three fields: (1) charcoal dark (~#1F2A2E) — primary brand mark, dark UI, equipment; (2) teal-green (~#1FAD6E) — progress accent, CTA, achievement; (3) clean white (~#F8F8F8) — breathing space, label ground, light surfaces. EXCLUDE: orange, aggressive red, neon, body-reveal contexts.

capture_character.value: Clean functional documentation — gym equipment in use (hands and tools, not bodies), outdoor activity top-down or wide-angle (no face/body close-ups), product flat-lay on rubber mat or clean counter. Motion suggested, not displayed. Progress shown through metrics (app screen) and props (programme card, supplement canister) — not body transformation images.

style_descriptor.value: Aspirational yet grounded. Clean studio meets real-world outdoor Saudi public spaces. Equipment-as-hero (dumbbell, mat, canister, app screen). No lifestyle excess. Every frame should feel achievable and specifically Saudi — park benches, rubber track, morning sky over Riyadh.

lighting.value: Morning natural light for outdoor shots (cool-to-warm transition, 6–8am golden hour). Clean diffuse fill for studio/product. No harsh flash. Equipment surfaces should look matte and technical, not shiny-plastic.

caption_style.value: calm_motivational — neutral Saudi Arabic, max 180 chars, one measurable truth or concrete action per caption; no hype language

sub_sector.value: Healthcare & Wellness — Fitness Center + Sports Nutrition

humor_tolerance.value: none — health is serious; warmth is OK, jokes are not

anti_attributes.value: No exposed athletic bodies. No before/after body transformation images. No locker room or bedroom settings. No clothing removal scenes. No sports bra / crop top / shorts content. No mixed-gender intimacy. No face close-ups. No body-mapping silhouette clothing. No medical claims without proof.
